subject.title: macOS launchd Gateway still restarts via gateway-update/update.run; document and honor auto-update kill-switch

question: Should `OPENCLAW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1` block supervised Gateway control-plane `update.run` handoffs, or remain limited to configured background auto-update applies?
rationale: The source boundary is clear, but the behavior changes the meaning of an existing operator environment variable and could block explicit user or control-plane update requests.

options.title: Broaden the existing kill-switch
options.body: Treat `OPENCLAW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1` as blocking supervised Gateway-originated managed `update.run` handoffs while leaving foreground CLI updates available and documented.

options.title: Keep explicit update.run separate
options.body: Document that the variable only disables configured `update.auto` applies and keep current `update.run` handoff behavior, with launchd reliability tracked separately.

recommendation.title: Broaden the existing kill-switch
recommendation.body: Treat `OPENCLAW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1` as blocking supervised Gateway-originated managed `update.run` handoffs while leaving foreground CLI updates available and documented.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle introduced the existing kill-switch and is the strongest history match for deciding whether its scope should expand.
